name: Escalator Detail
summary: Lightweight static 3.6m-rise escalator with 22 independent steps and a blank signage post.
description: Original compact escalator module with 22 ribbed separate steps, flattened terminal transitions, continuous raised skirts, rounded-return handrails, segmented glass balustrades, two toothed comb plates and a freestanding blank signpost on an independent floor base. Nominal 1m tread width, 6m footprint length and 3.6m deck rise. Static visual geometry for the GJH Virtual Mall.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared materials; no external models, textures, fonts or images. No random inputs.

interface.step_pivot: Tread centre of each independent rigid step; glTF positions are measured in reports/assets.json
interface.front: Lower entry at +Z; upper landing at -Z
interface.runtime: Static rest pose only. Future animation must author hidden return steps and animate the landing transitions. No animation, passenger transport, collider or interaction logic is included.

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and statistics are measured from the delivered GLB. The 1m clear tread sits inside a 1.32m casing. Overall width is 1.67m including an independent side sign base; the complete footprint is centred at the floor origin, so the tread centre is offset on X. The 6m length and 3.6m rise remain unchanged pending the owner dimension decision requested by advisor round 2. The central incline remains approximately 43.7 degrees. Proposed alternatives are measured in reports/dimension-options.json. All 22 treads remain horizontal with two flush treads at either terminal. Continuous skirts enclose the step sides. The complete sign has at least 130mm lateral separation from the casing, 144mm from the handrails and 174mm from the glass. Blue-green glass uses closed alpha-blended geometry with backface culling and no transmission pass. Source parts may intersect at assembled joints. Static visual geometry only; full mall integration, aggregate 200 draw-call budget, physical devices and transport engineering are unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials; no external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.advisor_round_2: Signage clearance corrected; incline dimension decision pending. See reports/dimension-options.json.
